Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The urine findings indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI) with significant bacteriuria (>100,000 CFU/mL E. coli), marked leukocyturia, positive nitrites, and leukocyte esterase. Presence of blood and mucus further supports infection. Low specific gravity may reflect dilute urine. No casts detected, suggesting no upper tract involvement. Clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy are recommended.
